subject: backward elimination in MQM for 4 way cross

messages.author: bb6cce4079fc308e
messages.subject: backward elimination in MQM for 4 way cross
parts:
Dear Karl and others,

I am manipulating a F2 outcross, which corresponds to 4 way cross using r/qtl. As I understood from the previous posts, the function stepwiseqtl doesn't handle 4 way cross properly so far. 

So instead, I built the MQM model (makeqtl), optimized the model (refineqtl) and then search for additional additive QTL (addqtl). I considered both 0.05 and 0.2 significance level from the scanone permutation test as threshold for additional QTL. Then when evaluating the new (optimized by refineqtl) MQM including the added additional QTL, I can only use the command fitqtl to perform a drop one analysis to see if any QTLs should be eliminated. However, I wonder such approach for backward elimination is appropriate, as the QTLs' positions are optimized for the full MQM, not for MQM dropping one QTL. Therefore, the comparison between the full MQM and MQM dropping one QTL might be biased. Unfortenately, I didn't find a good solution in the book or any other instruction materials on r/qtl. 

I would be very grateful if you have any ideas about better way of performing model comparisons for backward elimination in MQM.

Thank you a lot!

Xiaodong

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] backward elimination in MQM for 4 way cross
parts:
I've not worked directly with 4-way cross data myself, and so I'm not completely sure how well things work in that context.

But your concern about backward elimination seems a general one, and not specific to a four-way cross.

I'm not completely sure what you mean by bias in this context. You're fitting and comparing a series of models. Key questions are how to compare models, and then whether you are evaluating all of the ones you'd like to evaluate?

karl

Hi Karl and John,

In 2016 September, I tried to apply the function stepwiseqtl to my 4 way cross. But I got error message very frequently. It only worked for very few traits. I put up a post on it. The reply from Karl said that stepwiseqtl did not take into account 4 way cross then. So I turned to 'by hand' MQM approach. 

Karl, did you make any updates to stepwiseqtl code with respect to 4 way cross in later version of rqtl since 2016 September?

Thanks!

Xiaodong
